name: box1_whole_crate
description: Detect complete crate instances. Contents, dividers, cloth, and parts inside one crate are included in that crate mask, not split as separate objects.
prompts: complete whole plastic storage crate including any contents as one object
entire plastic logistics tote bin as a single object
whole rectangular plastic crate, ignore internal dividers and items
complete blue or gray plastic parts bin as one container

profiles.name: box1_multi_whole_crate
profiles.description: Two crates side by side or touching. Use size/front-back single-crate prompts so each crate is one complete instance and touching crates are separated, instead of a greedy whole-crate prompt that merges both or only catches the larger crate's liner.
prompts: larger plastic crate only as one object
smaller plastic crate only as one object
single front lower plastic crate only, not the crate behind it
single rear upper plastic crate only, not the crate in front

profiles.name: box1_151422_early_large_crate_interior_repair
profiles.description: Early 151422 frames have a large rear gray crate whose silver liner/interior is fragmented by the multi-container profile. Use side-specific inclusive prompts and convex completion so the large crate is contiguous while the small crate remains a separate instance.
prompts: large rear gray plastic crate including silver liner contents
large left gray plastic storage crate including everything inside
large gray plastic crate with shiny silver liner as one object
small right gray plastic crate only
small foreground gray plastic bin only
right side smaller plastic crate separate from large crate

profiles.name: box1_151422_late_right_attached_repair
profiles.description: Late 151422 frames have a right-side small crate attached to a large left crate. Use side-specific prompts so the large crate includes its internal liner/content and the small crate remains a separate instance.
prompts: large rear gray plastic crate including silver liner contents
large left gray plastic storage crate including everything inside
small right gray plastic crate only
small foreground gray plastic bin only
right side smaller plastic crate separate from large crate
